body:
## **Description** Unfunded Perps trade-screen users were seeing a disabled Insufficient funds button even though the page already knew they had no balance. The primary CTA is now an enabled Add funds to trade control, with a short hint and a labeled Add funds button on the available-to-trade row. Funnel events cover unfunded click, deposit opened, deposit confirmed, and a later order after that deposit. ## **Changelog** CHANGELOG entry: Enabled Add funds to trade on the Perps order screen when the account has no balance, so unfunded users can start a deposit from the primary button. ## **Related issues** Fixes: [TAT-3853](https://consensyssoftware.atlassian.net/browse/TAT-3853) ## **Manual testing steps** 1. Run the extension and unlock a wallet with $0 Perps balance (or switch to an account that has never deposited). 2. Open a market and go to the trade screen (`#/perps/trade/BTC`). 3. Confirm Available to trade is 0.00 USDC. 4. Confirm the footer button is enabled and labeled Add funds to trade, the hint under the summary is visible, and the available-to-trade row shows a labeled Add funds button (not only the + icon). 5. Click Add funds to trade. If geo-blocked, the geo-block modal opens. Otherwise the Perps deposit confirmation opens. 6. Switch back to a funded Perps account and confirm the footer still says Open long / Open short and is not stuck on Add funds. ## **Screenshots/Recordings** Re-validation after row-CTA loading-state fix: enabled Add funds to trade on the unfunded order form.
AC2: enabled Add funds to trade CTA on the unfunded order form

The footer becomes an enabled **Add funds to trade** action with a short hint, and the available-to-trade row shows a labeled **Add funds** button instead of only a **+** icon. > > Deposit starts from that primary CTA or the row control (still gated by eligibility/geo-block and compliance). A **sessionStorage** flag ties unfunded clicks through **deposit opened**, **deposit confirmed**, and **trade submitted after deposit** analytics, including **`amount_input`** vs **trading** button location and **`has_perp_balance`**. > > Account still loading at $0 does not show the unfunded CTA; submit stays disabled until balance is known. > > Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 002b882c412dba3dc489e0752d9060612c4dbdd2.
